The Group Insurance Benefits Booklet (page 8) pays the Other Fracture as a percentage of Daniel's own sum insured (S$300,000 on the certificate) for each listed case: Skull (Other Fracture) 100%; Hip (Other Fracture) 75%; Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture) 50%.

Other Fracture means a fracture that is not a Simple Fracture, including a compound (open) fracture. We will pay the percentage of the Sum Insured shown below.

Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which
independently of any other cause results in the Insured Person's death within 365 days of the Accident, we will
pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000, on receipt of proof of death and the original receipts.
This benefit is not payable for death caused by an illness.

calculations.sentence: If the Simple Fracture benefit applies to Daniel's case “Hip” (as you described: “the X-ray confirms it is his hip.”), the conditional illustration is S$3,750: 75% of the Simple Fracture benefit limit of S$5,000, under the Group Insurance Benefits Booklet; it is an illustration from the document's terms, not a payment or an insurer's decision, and only for an injury the insurer accepts as caused by an accident (the policy says “We will pay the percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit shown below for a Simple Fracture of a nature listed, caused by an Accident”).
